blocks.text:
Day 1 · Arrival in Rio de Janeiro. At the international airport, your driver meets you for the transfer to the hotel. The rest of the day is free to explore the city or enjoy your first day on its beautiful beaches.

Rio de Janeiro is a city of green hills, blue skies, lovely bays, islands and wonderful beaches: Brazil’s second-largest city after São Paulo, and one of the most beautiful in the world. Copacabana, Ipanema and Leblon are famous for their black-and-white mosaic promenades, where people play football and volleyball on the golden sand from morning until late evening. Rio offers almost every sport, from golf and tennis to surfing, diving and hang gliding, while beach cafés serve coconut water and fresh juices to the sound of local musicians.
